Primary service or workflow of interest

turns_before_attempt.content: Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide, an AI assistant. What would you like help with?

I, I uh have a plumbing supply business called Copper Mesa Supply. We have 6 staff that handle quote requests arriving by email. They copy details into a spreadsheet, but we sometimes miss requests. We want help collecting request details and preparing draft quotes. A person must approve every quote before anything goes to the customer though.

Thanks—that’s a clear fit to explore. AIowa Agents can help with workflow automation, and a documented use case is collecting request details from incoming messages and preparing drafts for human review. Your requirement that a person approve every quote before it goes out is an important constraint to keep in place.

One question: what tools do you currently use for quotes and customer communication—just the spreadsheet and email, or also a CRM or quoting software?
No, just uh email and Excel.

Got it—email and Excel only. That’s useful context. The documented workflow can work with email as the intake point and prepare draft quotes for your team to review, with human approval before anything is sent.

Would you like me to prepare a short human-review brief with what you’ve shared so far, so someone can follow up on next steps?
Yeah, do that and um, one correction, 4 staff handle those requests, not 6. We also use a supplier portal, but I don't know whether or not if it has an API.
